name: g66_trace_skips_stance
purpose: Trace and Stance Change (decision 0040): Gardevoir (F) leads with Trace against Aegislash (M, Stance Change, notrace) and Politoed (Drizzle). Trace's candidates are the foes whose ability has no notrace flag, so Aegislash is never copied: Gardevoir copies Drizzle from Politoed, the only candidate.
